approval_source: Explicit user SIGA in HNK-LINGUAS after the VALIVAN / PARAZAMO unresolved-vocabulary policy was presented.

decisions_requested.statement: Preserve VANUVALI (LEX-030) as GATE with master meaning null and remove it from the teachable L02 Vocabulary set until semantic evidence is recovered or separately governed.
Preserve VANI (LEX-031) as WATCH with master meaning null and remove it from the teachable L02 Vocabulary set; do not generalize the scoped L01 residence reading.
Approve recovered FROZEN VALIVAN (LEX-003, escritório) as an L02 curriculum rebind for the WORK_PLACE role, extending curriculum use to L02 without changing its recovered meaning or authority.

Approve recovered FROZEN PARAZAMO (LEX-004, escola / domínio de estudo) as an L02 curriculum rebind for the EDUCATION_PLACE role, extending curriculum use to L02 without changing its recovered meaning or authority.

Confirm that VALIVAN/PARAZAMO are preferred over SARU/TA for this gate because they are FROZEN recovered assets that directly fit the current urban/study/work semantic center and require less new microgrammar.

Confirm that a 16/16 semantically teachable source set does not itself validate any L02 curriculum slot; OPI, Story, Q&A, Structures, Vocabulary cards, Activation and Review remain unimplemented until the pedagogy-source contract is separately approved.
Confirm that no new HNK form, historical claim, numerological selection or authority promotion is created by this policy decision.
